name: Mordred Gaultier
source:
A more cynical, aloof master than the young heir of Gaultier would be hard to find. Mordred doesn't get along well with anyone, particularly not his troubled parents–but he doesn't really seem to care.

Despite clearly resenting his life at the manor, he endures regular abuse at the hands of his father. But is there another reason for Mordred bitterness? Perhaps one buried deep beneath his prickly attitude...

[From the [url=https://mordred-f.jimdo.com/]official site[/url]]
